text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian parliament adopted the law regulating the use of flags of minorities in an unpleasant and tense atmosphere. Not only opposition deputies but also members of the ruling Social Democratic Union (SDAM) voted against the law.

- The government negotiating with AUDI car producer on a multi million dollar deal for production in Macedonia. If the deal falls through the government will call an international tender for production of cars in the country.
